title: 金门大桥 · 句子听写

sents.t: Every day, more than 110,000 automobiles cross a historic and beautiful bridge in northern California.
sents.zh: 每天有超过 11 万辆汽车驶过北加州一座历史悠久又美丽的大桥。

sents.t: The span is called the Golden Gate Bridge.
sents.zh: 这座桥叫金门大桥。

sents.t: It is named after the body of water below it.
sents.zh: 它是以桥下的那片水域命名的。

sents.t: The Golden Gate Strait connects the Pacific Ocean with San Francisco Bay.
sents.zh: 金门海峡把太平洋和旧金山湾连在一起。

sents.t: The distance between the main towers is almost 1,300 meters long.
sents.zh: 两座主塔之间的距离将近 1300 米。

sents.t: That was the longest suspension bridge span in the world for almost thirty years.
sents.zh: 近三十年里，这都是世界上跨度最长的悬索桥。

sents.t: Then, in 1964, the larger Verrazano Narrows bridge opened in New York City.
sents.zh: 后来在 1964 年，更大的韦拉扎诺海峡大桥在纽约市通车。

sents.t: Strauss used newly developed protective equipment for the men who worked on the bridge.
sents.zh: 施特劳斯为建桥工人使用了新研发的防护装备。

sents.t: These included a special safety net under the bridge.
sents.zh: 其中包括桥下一张特制的安全网。

sents.t: But still, 11 workers fell to their deaths during the building project.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，施工期间还是有 11 名工人坠落身亡。

sents.t: The color of the bridge, international orange, is very important.
sents.zh: 大桥的颜色——国际橙——非常重要。

sents.t: It was chosen partly because it is easier to see through the heavy fog that often covers San Francisco.
sents.zh: 选它的部分原因是：在常常笼罩旧金山的浓雾里，这个颜色更容易看清。

sents.t: Many people consider the Golden Gate Bridge the most beautiful bridge of its kind in the world.
sents.zh: 很多人认为金门大桥是世界上同类桥中最美的一座。

sents.t: More than 2 billion vehicles have crossed the bridge since its opening.
sents.zh: 自通车以来，已有超过 20 亿辆车驶过这座桥。

sents.t: But wheels are not the only way to cross the bridge.
sents.zh: 不过，轮子（坐车）并不是过桥的唯一方式。

sents.t: Many people walk across each year and there is no cost to do so.
sents.zh: 每年很多人步行过桥，而且这样做不花钱。

sents.t: On clear days, the bridge provides excellent views of San Francisco, ships down below and birds all around.
sents.zh: 天气晴朗时，在桥上能看到旧金山、桥下的船和四周的飞鸟，景色极好。

sents.t: At last the mighty task is done; resplendent in the western sun
sents.zh: 这项宏伟的工程终于完成；在西边的阳光里熠熠生辉

sents.t: The Bridge looms mountain high; its titan piers grip ocean floor,
sents.zh: 大桥像山一样高高耸现；巨大的桥墩紧紧抓住海底，

sents.t: Its great steel arms link shore with shore,
sents.zh: 它巨大的钢铁臂膀把两岸连在一起，

sents.t: Its towers pierce the sky.
sents.zh: 它的高塔直插云霄。
